둘.forms: native · counting things, hours, age · before a counter: 두 (두 개, 두 시)
둘.t: Before a counter 둘 becomes 두: 두 사람, 두 잔.

나오다.m: to come out, to get out; to appear
나오다.x: My friend came out of the room.
나오다.e: 나다 (come out) + 오다 (come); opposite of 들어오다. 나가다 = go out.

의.forms: noun + 의 + noun (친구의 책) · 나의 → 내, 저의 → 제, 너의 → 네
의.e: 나의 shortens to 내 (my), 저의 to 제.
의.t: As a particle it's usually pronounced [에]. It's often dropped in speech: 친구 책.

일자리.ex: 요즘 젊은 사람들이 일자리를 찾기가 어려워요.
일자리.x: These days it's hard for young people to find jobs.
일자리.e: Built from 일 'work' + 자리 'seat, spot': a spot to work.
일자리.t: Pronounced [일짜리] — the ㅈ becomes tense after ㄹ.

게다가.m: besides, on top of that, moreover
게다가.ex: 게다가 그 식당은 가격도 아주 싸요.
게다가.x: On top of that, the restaurant is very cheap too.
게다가.e: Probably a contraction of 거기에다가 'adding to that'.

데리다.m: to take, to bring along (someone of equal or lower status)
데리다.x: On the weekend I took my child to the park.
데리다.e: Native verb that is rarely used on its own; it lives on in 데리고, 데리러 and the compounds 데려가다 and 데려오다.
데리다.t: Use 데리다 for children, friends and pets. For parents, teachers and other elders, switch to the honorific 모시다: 할머니를 모시고 갔어요.

만족스럽다.x: I'm very pleased with the results of this exam.
만족스럽다.e: -스럽다 turns a noun into 'feeling like N': 만족스럽다, 자랑스럽다.

농업.ex: 이 지역 사람들은 대부분 농업에 종사합니다.
농업.x: Most people in this area work in agriculture.
농업.e: Literally 'farming industry'; -업 = industry: 농업, 산업, 어업.

프로그래머.x: My younger sibling works as a programmer at a game company.
프로그래머.e: From English 'programmer'; extra 으 vowels break up the English consonant clusters.
프로그래머.t: In tech companies, 개발자 'developer' is the more common everyday word.

무조건.ex: 내일은 중요한 시험이 있어서 무조건 일찍 일어나야 해요.
무조건.x: I have an important exam tomorrow, so I absolutely have to get up early.
무조건.t: Pronounced [무조껀]; in casual speech it also means 'definitely': 무조건 맛있어 'it's guaranteed delicious.'

공평하다.ex: 부모님은 우리 형제를 항상 공평하게 대해 주셨어요.
공평하다.x: Our parents always treated us siblings fairly.
공평하다.t: 공평하다 means everyone gets equal treatment; 공정하다 means the process or rules are just.

청력.ex: 나이가 들면 청력이 약해질 수 있어요.
청력.x: Your hearing can get weaker as you get older.
청력.t: Pronounced [청녁] — the ㄹ becomes ㄴ after ㅇ.

원어민.ex: 원어민 선생님과 매주 회화 수업을 해요.
원어민.x: I have a conversation class with a native-speaker teacher every week.
원어민.t: 원어민처럼 말하다 means 'to speak like a native'.

교도소.x: That criminal is in prison now.

투표율.x: Voter turnout in this election exceeded 70 percent.
투표율.t: Write -율 after a vowel or ㄴ, -률 after other consonants: 투표율 but 합격률.

최대한.forms: 최대한 + verb: 최대한 빨리, 최대한 노력하다; noun: 최대한으로
최대한.m: as much as possible, to the maximum
최대한.x: I'll get back to you as soon as possible.

정착하다.ex: 그 가족은 십 년 전에 미국에 정착했어요.
정착하다.x: That family settled in the U.S. ten years ago.
정착하다.e: Literally 'fixed and attached' — staying put in one place.

발목을 잡다.forms: 발목을 잡아요 · 발목을 잡았어요 · 발목을 잡히다 (to be held back)
발목을 잡다.m: to hold someone back, to be a drag on, to hinder
발목을 잡다.ex: 이번에도 부상이 그 선수의 발목을 잡았어요.
발목을 잡다.x: Once again, an injury held that athlete back.
발목을 잡다.e: 발목 = ankle; literally 'to grab someone's ankle' so they can't move forward.

장벽.ex: 언어의 장벽 때문에 처음에는 많이 힘들었어요.
장벽.x: At first it was really hard because of the language barrier.

먹방.x: Watching mukbang at night makes me hungry.
먹방.e: 먹(다) 'to eat' + 방(송) 'broadcast'; now borrowed into English as 'mukbang'.
먹방.t: Pronounced [먹빵]. Jokingly, 먹방 찍었어요 means 'I really pigged out.'

쿠데타.x: A military coup broke out in that country.
쿠데타.t: Collocation: 쿠데타를 일으키다 = to stage a coup.

비대면.ex: 코로나 이후 비대면 수업이 많이 늘었어요.
비대면.x: Remote classes increased a lot after COVID.
비대면.t: Used before nouns like an adjective: 비대면 수업 (remote class), 비대면 진료 (telemedicine).

급락하다.m: to plunge, to drop sharply (prices, rates)

기꺼이.x: If you need help, I'd be glad to help you.
기꺼이.e: Adverb of 기껍다 'to be glad, pleased'.
기꺼이.t: Common in polite offers: 기꺼이 ~해 드릴게요 'I'd be happy to ~ for you.'

획일성.ex: 교육의 획일성이 학생들의 창의력을 떨어뜨린다는 비판이 있어요.
획일성.x: Some criticize the uniformity of education for stifling students' creativity.
획일성.e: Literally 'drawn into one line': everything made the same.

자본금.x: That company started with 100 million won in capital.

신고자.m: person who reports (to police or authorities), informant, caller
신고자.x: Police strictly protect the identity of people who report crimes.
신고자.e: -자 = person who does it: 신고자 'one who reports', 운전자, 과학자.

언론인.x: He worked as a journalist for thirty years.
언론인.t: Pronounced [얼로닌] — ㄴ before ㄹ becomes ㄹ.

내부 고발.ex: 직원의 내부 고발로 회사의 비리가 드러났습니다.
내부 고발.x: An employee's whistleblowing exposed the company's corruption.

장기 기증.ex: 그는 사후에 장기 기증을 하기로 약속했어요.
장기 기증.x: He promised to donate his organs after death.
장기 기증.t: 장기 also means 'long-term' and 'Korean chess' — context makes the meaning clear.

널뛰기.ex: 설날에 민속촌에서 처음으로 널뛰기를 해 봤어요.
널뛰기.x: On Lunar New Year I tried seesaw jumping for the first time at a folk village.
널뛰기.t: Two people stand on the ends of a long board laid over a bundle and take turns jumping, launching each other into the air. Traditionally played by women at 설날.

투기꾼.ex: 정부는 부동산 투기꾼을 막기 위해 규제를 강화했습니다.
투기꾼.x: The government tightened regulations to stop real estate speculators.
투기꾼.e: 투기 'speculation' + native -꾼 'someone who habitually does it,' as in 사기꾼 'con artist.'
투기꾼.t: -꾼 sounds negative or slangy; the neutral word for an investor is 투자자.

수사권.x: A bill expanding the police's investigative authority was passed.
수사권.t: Pronounced [수사꿘] — 권 is tensed after many Sino nouns.

대전제.ex: 삼단논법에서 대전제가 틀리면 결론도 믿을 수 없어요.
대전제.x: In a syllogism, if the major premise is wrong, the conclusion can't be trusted either.
대전제.e: Literally 'big premise'; 전제 is something put forward beforehand.
대전제.t: Also used figuratively for a non-negotiable starting point: 안전이 대전제입니다 (Safety is the top priority).

시기심.x: Seeing my friend's success, I started to feel envious.
시기심.t: 시기심 is spiteful envy; 부러움 is harmless, often admiring envy.

인터페이스.ex: 새 앱은 인터페이스가 단순해서 쓰기 편해요.
인터페이스.x: The new app has a simple interface, so it's easy to use.
인터페이스.e: From English 'interface'; note the f becomes ㅍ.

석유화학.x: Most plastic is made from petrochemical products.
석유화학.e: Literally 'stone-oil chemistry'; 석유 'petroleum' is literally 'rock oil.'
석유화학.t: Pronounced [서규화학] — the final ㄱ links to the next vowel.

독립투사.ex: 그 독립투사는 평생을 조국의 독립을 위해 바쳤어요.
독립투사.x: That independence fighter devoted his whole life to his homeland's independence.
독립투사.e: Literally 'fighter for standing alone', that is, for independence.
독립투사.t: Pronounced [동닙투사] — ㄱ and ㄹ both shift to nasal sounds.

상정하다.m: to submit (a bill) to the agenda, to table
상정하다.x: The National Assembly put the bill on the plenary session agenda.
상정하다.t: A homonym 상정하다 (想定) means 'to assume, to suppose', mostly in academic writing.

특권층.ex: 특권층만 누리는 혜택에 대한 비판이 커졌어요.
특권층.x: Criticism grew over benefits that only the privileged enjoy.
